tax.text: He promoted tax cuts and said they would prevent an average tax increase for families in his district.
tax.quote: No tax on tips or overtime, permanent tax cuts for working families, and relief for seniors — sparing FL-26 taxpayers an average 24% tax increase.

schools.text: He said he increased charter school funding and backed a federal school-choice tax credit.
schools.quote: Increased charter school funding by $60 million, preserved Pell Grants and magnet schools, and backed the first federal school choice tax credit.

safety.text: He said he secured funding for regional law enforcement and championed enforcement-focused legislation.
safety.quote: Delivered over $11 million in FY26 funding for Miami-Dade and regional law enforcement — new patrol vehicles, upgraded technology, and mobile command centers — while championing House-passed bills like the LEOSA Reform Act and the Combatting Organized Retail Crime Act.

immigration.text: He said he prioritized border security, detention, and the swift removal of criminal noncitizens in homeland-security funding.
immigration.quote: Led FY26 Homeland Security funding prioritizing border security, detention and swift removal of criminal aliens, and expanded resources to stop fentanyl trafficking

schools.text: She supports strong and equitable funding for K–12 schools.
schools.quote: I support universal pre-K and childcare, strong and equitable funding for K-12 schools, protections for students with disabilities and civil rights enforcement.

immigration.text: She supports pathways to citizenship for long-term residents, Dreamers, and TPS holders, and opposes using detention to punish families seeking safety.
immigration.quote: I support a humane, lawful immigration system that keeps families together, protects due process, and provides a pathway to citizenship for long-term residents, Dreamers, and TPS holders.

health.text: She supports a path to universal healthcare, including options such as Medicare for All or a public option.
health.quote: Nicole supports the fastest responsible path to guaranteed care for every American: Medicare for All, a strong public option, Medicare buy-in, or any model that gets us to universal coverage.

energy.text: She supports investing in clean energy and says federal inaction on climate change will cost more than prevention.
energy.quote: Federal inaction will cost far more than prevention. We must invest in clean energy, resilient infrastructure, conservation, and stronger protections for communities and workers.

voting.text: She opposes documentary proof requirements that create barriers and says voting should be made easier for eligible Americans.
voting.quote: We should be making it easier for every American to vote, and we should do everything we can to encourage voter participation and education.

schools.text: She supports federal funding and programs for K–12 public schools, including Title I and IDEA.
schools.quote: At the K–12 level, the federal government should support Title I, enforce civil‑rights protections, fully fund IDEA, and expand school breakfast and lunch programs.

immigration.text: She supports expanding legal pathways and protections for Dreamers, TPS holders, and long-term residents.
immigration.quote: TPS and DACA must be restored and expanded, and Dreamers must have permanent protection and access to education.

guns.text: She supports common gun-safety laws that restrict military-style weapons.
guns.quote: Safety requires national school‑security standards, a uniform Code Red system, and common gun‑safety laws restricting military‑style weapons.

health.text: She supports universal health care and expanded in-home care for seniors.
health.quote: I also support universal healthcare to reduce premiums, lower prescription costs, and expand in‑home care so seniors can remain safely at home.

voting.text: She favors making voting easier and opposes barriers that could disenfranchise eligible voters.
voting.quote: We should be making it easier for every American to vote, and we should do everything we can to encourage voter participation and education.
